title: Does joint serum total CO2 and hemoglobin encoding improve albuminuria prediction across NHANES cycles?
abstract: In exploratory NHANES 2009–2010 to 2015–2016 transfer (n=4510/4208), a serum total-CO2-by-hemoglobin spline surface changed weighted log-UACR MSE from 0.800271 to 0.844003, delta +0.043732 (joint PSU-bootstrap 95% [+0.014426,+1.863358]). The registered improvement criterion failed.
